name: TeamStarWolf - Water and Wastewater Networks (Enterprise)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. The 21 Enterprise techniques that the verified record in case-studies/WATER_TREATMENT_NETWORKS.md supports: the technique tables of AA21-287A, AA23-335A, AA25-343A and AA26-097A, plus Inferred mappings from the wording of AA24-038A, AA21-287A, WaterISAC's Fundamentals and the July 2026 FBI and EPA PSA. Scores: 100 listed, 40 Inferred. Each comment names the records and the study's source numbers.
